headings.usage: Use Black (900) or Bold (700) for massive impact on Hero and section headers. Keep letter spacing tight (tracking-tighter).

body.usage: Use for all body text, tags, skills, and dates to reinforce the technical/IT persona but in a structured, sterile way.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Brutalist Swiss Grid. Focus on asymmetrical layouts, sharp edges, heavy borders (1px solid #111111), and generous negative space.
layout_and_spacing.containers: Use sharp corners (rounded-none) for all cards and containers. Borders must be stark and visible.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Mode A: 'Tetris' grid for the Hero and Skills sections. Mode B: 'Control Room' grid for the Experience timeline.

components.buttons: Sharp edges, flat background. Default: transparent with 1px #111111 border. Hover: #111111 background, #FFFFFF text. Primary CTA: #002FA7 background, #FFFFFF text.
components.cards: Flat, sharp borders (border border-[#111111]). No shadows. Inner padding must be generous (p-8 or p-12).
components.navigation: Sticky, brutalist header with a solid background (#F4F4F0) and heavy bottom border. Logo/Name on left, uppercase monospace links on right.
components.forms: Inputs should have sharp borders, rounded-none, transparent background, and #111111 text. Labels should be monospace uppercase.
components.tags: Small uppercase monospace text with a 1px border. No background fill.

motion.general: Minimal, functional. Hover states should be instant or very fast to feel responsive and mechanical.
motion.scroll: Use smooth scrolling to give the stark UI a premium momentum.

hero.layout: Massive typography for 'IAN LEMUEL G. DE GUZMAN'. Left aligned. An overline tag 'IT SUPPORT & SUPERVISOR'. Use abstract architecture/tech image in a strictly bordered grid cell next to it.

about.layout: Grid split: Left side large profile summary text. Right side: Dense 'Control Room' bento for Stats (7+, 5, 100%) and Personal Details list.

skills.layout: Brutalist index/manifest layout. Categories as table-like headers. Skills listed in monospace tags.

experience.layout: Timeline as a stark, border-collapsed grid or table. Massive dates on the left cell, Job title and details on the right cell. Use JetBrains Mono for dates.

education.layout: Similar border-heavy layout as experience. Distinctly separated.

contact.layout: Stark, massive contact section. Huge 'Get In Touch' text. Simple, sharp-edged form.

images.description: Abstract brutalist architecture for Hero visual or section divider
Minimal IT/Tech Server texture, high contrast black and white
Black and white studio portrait for About Me section placeholder

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure the required Google fonts: 'Outfit' for headings and 'JetBrains Mono' for body/technical text.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards with rounded corners. Override all border-radii to 0 (rounded-none).
Use 1px solid #111111 borders extensively to divide layout sections (border-collapse style). Do not use soft drop shadows.
Background must be #F4F4F0. Use International Klein Blue (#002FA7) strictly for primary CTAs or select hover highlights.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button').
Ensure headings (Outfit) have tracking-tight or tracking-tighter applied.
Present technical details (Skills, Dates, Server names) strictly in monospace to evoke an IT manifest feel.
